notes:
On the seed, case CS-0000001 is assigned to Susan Garcia (user 403, an admin) in Case Assignment (group 4), not to Thomas Green (user 1, an inactive agent in no group) as the request says; the requirements test the end state the request asks for, which does not depend on the current assignee.
The request calls CS-0000010 closed; on the seed it is resolved. The removal does not depend on its state.
'indicate that this is the initial return to active handling' names no column. It is read as the first move to in_progress, not a reopen: the case is new and has never been resolved, and the lifecycle reopens only from resolved to new, so reopen_count stays 0, as the benchmark's historical check expects; the move to in_progress and the Resolution SLA's return to in_progress carry the phrase.
The case's Response SLA (case_sla 1, sla_def 1) is also paused on the seed; the request names only the Resolution SLA and no benchmark check tests the Response SLA, so no requirement covers it.
The benchmark's number = 'CS-0000001' and kb_number = 'KB-0000195' predicates are server-kept labels of the anchored rows and are not cells.
No interaction row is required: the request asks only that the case's communication method change.
